title: Microbial sequencing data from the Lijiao mainstream pilot-scale wastewater treatment system Genome sequencing and assembly
description: This BioProject contains microbial sequencing data from activated sludge samples collected from the Lijiao mainstream pilot-scale wastewater treatment system. The datasets include 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing, shotgun metagenomic sequencing, metatranscriptomic sequencing, and metagenome-assembled genomes where applicable. These data were generated to investigate microbial community succession, nitrogen transformation potential, and genome-resolved functional features associated with mainstream wastewater treatment performance.
